title: Miso Butter Pasta
description: A five-ingredient pasta that tastes like it has no business being this good. White miso, butter, and parmesan melt into a savory, umami-rich sauce using nothing but pasta water and elbow grease.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta, stirring occasionally, until al dente according to package directions.
Reserve 1 1/4 cups pasta water, then drain the pasta.
steps.tip: This starchy water is the backbone of the sauce — don't skip it.

steps.text: Return the pot to medium heat. Add the butter, miso, and reserved pasta water. Whisk until the miso dissolves and the liquid looks uniform, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the drained pasta and parmesan. Toss vigorously with tongs, working the pasta through the sauce until the cheese melts and the sauce emulsifies into a glossy, clingy coating, about 2 minutes.
steps.tip: Treat this like cacio e pepe — aggressive tossing is what builds the emulsion. If the sauce breaks or gets too thick, splash in a bit more pasta water.

steps.text: Divide among shallow bowls and top with furikake or crumbled nori, if using.
